name: Orion
description: The Hunter, with bright Betelgeuse, Rigel, and the famous three-star belt.

name: Ursa Major
description: The Great Bear, home to the Big Dipper pointing toward Polaris.

name: Scorpius
description: The Scorpion with brilliant red Antares at its heart.

name: Leo
description: The Lion with first-magnitude Regulus at its heart.

name: Cassiopeia
description: The Queen, a distinctive W-shape circumpolar constellation.

name: Cygnus
description: The Swan, home to the Northern Cross and bright Deneb.

name: Lyra
description: The Lyre, home to brilliant Vega — third brightest star.

name: Aquila
description: The Eagle with first-magnitude Altair, part of the Summer Triangle.

name: Gemini
description: The Twins Castor and Pollux, a rich zodiac constellation.

name: Taurus
description: The Bull with red giant Aldebaran and the Pleiades star cluster.

name: Virgo
description: The Maiden with Spica and the Virgo galaxy cluster.

name: Perseus
description: The Hero, containing variable star Algol and the Double Cluster.

name: Andromeda
description: Princess Andromeda, home to the Great Andromeda Galaxy M31.

name: Pegasus
description: The Winged Horse, forming the Great Square of Pegasus.

name: Sagittarius
description: The Archer, pointing toward the Milky Way galactic center.

name: Boötes
description: The Herdsman with orange giant Arcturus — fourth brightest star.

name: Auriga
description: The Charioteer with brilliant Capella — sixth brightest star.

name: Canis Major
description: The Great Dog with Sirius — the brightest star in the night sky.

name: Corona Borealis
description: The Northern Crown, a beautiful semicircular arc of stars.

name: Hercules
description: The Hero, one of the largest constellations with the M13 globular cluster.
